coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): Sole Notion owner for the seven titles `[Course Code] - [Course Name]`. For each title, exhaust `API-post-search`, filter exact matches, create at most once on zero with `API-post-page(parent={"workspace":true}, properties={"title":{"title":[{"type":"text","text":{"content":<exact title>}}]}}, children=[<canonical paragraph block>])`, reuse one retained page, and block on multiple matches or an ambiguous create. For a reused page, retrieve it and use `API-patch-block-children` only to add a missing canonical paragraph. The paragraph contains code, Fall 2014, dates, StudentEnrollment count, assignment count, and all instructor names/emails. Search the title again, require exactly the retained ID, and read its complete child-block text back.
